parameters.errorMessage: P05 lookup customer: input item needs email or external_id

parameters.query:
select id, external_id, name, email, phone, company, country, city, segment, created_at
  from customers
 where ($1::text is not null and external_id = $1)
    or ($1::text is null and lower(email) = $2)
 order by id
 limit 1

nodes.name: Find customer
nodes.notes: SELECT is safe to retry. Always output data: a miss is one empty item, so Result still runs.

parameters.content:
## P05 - Lookup customer (sub-workflow contract)
Call with `{email}` or `{external_id}` -> `{ok, found, customer_id, name, email, company, segment, ..., response}`.

The contract every shared block follows: **passthrough trigger** -> **validate** (Stop and Error names the block and the field) -> **normalize** -> **one documented job** (`.retry` where safe) -> **Result**: exactly one flat item with `ok` + `response`.

Not found is an answer (`ok: true, found: false`), not an error. Breaking changes get a new folder and id (`P05b-...`), never a silent edit - callers pin `catalog_id("P05")`.

meta.description: Reference building block for the sub-workflow contract: {email | external_id} in, one flat {ok, found, ..., response} item out; bad input -> Stop and Error.
